If you believe you have found a security issue in biop-ai which is not
suitable for a [public issue report](https://github.com/BioAGI-org/biop-ai/issues)
on GitHub, please email Dan Bolser at dan.bolser@gmail.com.

biop-ai is a fork of Biopython, and most of its code is shared with it. If
the issue is in Biopython too, please also tell its maintainers, following
[Biopython's security policy](https://github.com/biopython/biopython/blob/master/.github/SECURITY.md).
